text_block_list.text:
The Kinko Sho.
Kawakami Princess ran it to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Kh...!

A form designed to showcase beauty
by focusing on the tips of her hands and feet.
That is—
It looked awkward.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *wheeze*, *gasp*... *pant*.
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(My body is... heavy.
Has it always been like this...?)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Princess! Way to go!
That's our heroine for ya!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, since you're already here!
Make a cool declaration here too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Tell 'em you'll crush 'em!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh, but—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Those words were meant to hurt others, and that's wrong.
They were so far from how a true queen should speak—)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? What was I supposed to do
after the race ended again?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Should I call out to the fans?
But I'm not the only star here.
To act like a true queen, umm—)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(――What kind of expression did PreFighter
always show to everyone...?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (...What should I... do......)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ha, hahaha... ehehe...
Kawakami Princess forced a smile, looking troubled and on the verge of tears—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's with that creepy laugh?!
That's not you at all!!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! Authorized personnel only!
Please return to the spectator area at once!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm not moving!
I'm definitely not moving an inch
until Kawakami listens to what I have to say!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Ms. Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Lame! That's so lame, Kawakami!!
Why are you making a face like that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even though you said earlier that you'd live your life
without abandoning who you are or your dignity!
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're not acting like yourself at all!!
You're not the Kawakami I know right now!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Give me back the old Kawakami!
Give me back the Kawakami I loved!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kh, please don't say such irresponsible things!
A princess must carry herself with dignity at all times!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"You wouldn't like it either!
If the victor wasn't someone you could respect...!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care about that at all!
It doesn't bother me one bit!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Even if you don't mind...!
Everyone else...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: Acting with dignity is the right thing to do.
Acting with dignity is the right thing to do, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: Still, I think staying true to yourself is the right choice too.
But I think staying true to yourself is the right thing too

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, both of them are right, aren't they?
Then what should I...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "...What... what am I supposed to do now...?"
choice_data_list: Why don't you take another look at your "ideal form"?
Why don't you take another look at your "ideal form"?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ..."Ideal form"?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Move it already!
You have your next race coming up, you know!!

"And so, practically ushered out by the staff,
we left the track."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm entering the Victoria Mile.
You better enter too. Once you're in better shape, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Let me tell you this upfront. It wouldn't be like you
to do nothing after being told all that."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...The Victoria Mile.
Kawakami Princess is surely feeling lost.

I didn't know the difference between being true to myself and being selfish.
Nor the difference between acting with dignity and simply enduring.

I was losing sight of how to act like the
"ideal princess" that she truly wishes for deep down—

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text:
"Chukyo Racecourse is on fire this month!
The spring blitz, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, is finally here!"

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text: "That top-class Umamusume has also declared her entry! Which one will be crowned the Sprint Queen?!"

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text:
“Plus, there's a PreFie Show happening too!
Families who come together can even get free merch♪”

—Before heading to the Victoria Mile.
The ideal she strives for surely lies ahead.
As her Trainer, I will guide Kawakami Princess toward the best path for her.
